metadata.title: The suboptimal Penrose inequality for charged initial data sets
metadata.abstract: Given a complete, 3-dimensional, asymptotically flat initial data set for the Einstein-Maxwell equations with vanishing magnetic field, we show that there exists a small universal constant $\mathcal{C}$ such that $m\geq\mathcal{C}(\sqrt{\mathcal{A}/(16\pi)}+\mathcal{Q}^2\sqrt{\pi/\mathcal{A}}\,)$. An analogous statement holds for asymptotically hyperboloidal initial data sets with the ADM mass replaced by hyperbolic energy. Under the additional assumption of axisymmetry, the inequality may be further strengthened to include angular momentum. These results extend the Penrose-type inequalities recently obtained by Allen-Bryden-Kazaras-Khuri to the charged setting.

analysis.progressType: 带电 Penrose 型不等式
analysis.workSummary: 对无磁场的三维渐近平坦 Einstein–Maxwell 初始数据，建立含面积和电荷项、带小普适常数的质量下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 推广既有次优 Penrose 不等式到带电与渐近双曲情形，轴对称下可纳入角动量。
analysis.limitations: 常数为次优普适常数，不是完整锐 Penrose 不等式；详细能量及边界假设须查原文。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
